description: Defines a template class 'logger_impl' for thread-safe logging control, including setting levels, context, and hex dump size. Also provides type traits, logger type aliases, and a basic logger with four levels.

classes.name: logger_impl
classes.description: Template class providing thread-safe logging level control, context setting, and hex dump size configuration.

methods.name: set_level
methods.description: Sets the logging level, enabling/disabling channels accordingly.

methods.name: set_context
methods.description: Sets context values for all channels.

methods.name: set_hex_dump_max_size
methods.description: Sets maximum size for hex dump in all channels.
